extraction.notes: Three-month (Quarter Ended June 30, 2024) column. EQR has no AFFO metric; affo fields null. The FFO subtotal used is the printed 'FFO' line (366,703), which is before preferred distributions (-355); FFO available to Common Shares and Units (366,348) and Normalized FFO available to Common Shares and Units (380,142) are after preferred distributions and are not used as totals. Starting line Net income 183,555 plus adjustments reproduces 366,703; Normalized FFO 380,497 reproduces from FFO plus core adjustments. Debt extinguishment line is printed as a dash for Q2 2024 (recorded as 0). 'Depreciation – Partially Owned Properties' (-547) was categorized as re_depreciation (consolidated JV real estate depreciation removed for NCI share); categorization is a judgment call. Non-operating asset (gains) losses (2,890) categorized as 'other' since it is not clearly real estate or securities. Diluted share count 390,542 reproduces diluted FFO/share 0.94 (366,348/390,542) and Normalized FFO/share 0.97 (380,142/390,542). Recurring capex is disclosed only on a six-month basis (83,456, page 25); no quarterly figure found on these pages.
